terms.gloss: a ploughman; in the poets, a farmer
evidence: Tib. 2.1.5: lūce sacrā requiēscat arātor (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Agricola equum suum ad stabulum dūcit.
phrases.english: The farmer is leading his horse to the stable.

phrases.latin: lūce sacrā requiēscat humus, requiēscat arātor
phrases.english: on the holy day let the soil rest, let the ploughman rest

sources: Lewis & Short: agricola
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 166, 313.
